blocks.html: dadmor is an independent, technical studio for founders who need a website, product, business model, document, security test, or content system that is scoped clearly, built precisely, and maintained honestly, not just delivered beautifully.
Three principles every project is built on

items: Clarity before build: scope, deliverables, exclusions, what we need from you and ownership are written down before design.
Technical precision to handover: accessible, fast, secure by default, documented and maintainable.
Honesty after launch: limits are stated, work samples carry a role label, and retest or revision rules are in writing.

blocks.html: dadmor works as one studio: the people who scope your project stay with it to handover. We take a limited number of projects at a time, so scope, build and handover stay with the same people.
Design and build (websites, UI, documentation) · Strategy and security (business model, penetration testing) · Content (marketing, copy, SEO)
dadmor plays on mordad. Dad means both justice and gift, and we read those two meanings this way: be fair to the client, and hand over work that stays useful after we leave.
